class.lmpc_classes.none.role: Empty hands: no bonuses, no penalties
class.lmpc_classes.cleric.role: The party's healer in the late stages of the plague
class.lmpc_classes.cleric.lore: Brew and prayer are powerless where the plague takes its due — but the Cleric stays close when every other remedy has stopped working. A steady hand and a voice right at your ear sometimes matter more than any recipe.
class.lmpc_classes.cleric.ability.1: The pendant in the necklace slot slows infection; on a Cleric it is twice as strong as on anyone else.
class.lmpc_classes.cleric.ability.2: The improved brew cures at any stage. In other hands the bottle is simply wasted.
class.lmpc_classes.cleric.ability.3: Feed an ally: stand right next to them and hold right-click while looking at them.
class.lmpc_classes.cleric.ability.4: Wounds close on their own, even on an empty stomach - faster with higher mastery.
class.lmpc_classes.cleric.mastery: Mastery grows with every successful cure; healing an ally is worth twice healing yourself.
class.lmpc_classes.smith.role: Defence technician, keeps the surface Purifiers running
class.lmpc_classes.smith.lore: While others run from the Blight, the Smith builds what keeps it at arm's length. A machine never tires and never fears — but it is hungry, and without its keeper it rusts like any abandoned mechanism.
class.lmpc_classes.smith.ability.1: Gear in hand and on the body slowly repairs itself — a machine with a keeper does not rust.
class.lmpc_classes.smith.mastery: Mastery grows from forged gear, from smelting, and from every night the land is cleansed.
class.lmpc_classes.farmer.role: Turns the run for plague reagents into husbandry
class.lmpc_classes.farmer.lore: What grows as a wild bush in the Blight is a risk for anyone who goes after it empty-handed. The Farmer has tamed it: the same thing comes up in rows on the farm plot, safe and predictable, like any other harvest.
class.lmpc_classes.farmer.ability.1: Every dish is more filling: a share of its own nutrition is added on top.
class.lmpc_classes.farmer.mastery: Mastery grows with every fully grown crop harvested.
class.lmpc_classes.chronicler.lore: The Chronicler goes where nobody else wants to look, and writes down what was seen — in case they do not come back. Every photograph and every line will one day be the only testimony that any of this was here.
class.lmpc_classes.chronicler.ability.1: Sees the exact plague stage and infection points — their own and everyone nearby.
class.lmpc_classes.chronicler.mastery: Mastery grows from deciphered words, from snapshots, and for every minute spent near someone infected.
gui.lmpc_classes.altar.title: Altar of Calling
gui.lmpc_classes.altar.locked: You can change class in %s min.
gui.lmpc_classes.codex.title: Codex of Calling
gui.lmpc_classes.codex.tier_max: There is nowhere higher to go.
item.lmpc_classes.clerics_pendant.toolti: An apothecary's sampler: the spore sac in its gold frame darkened before anyone felt ill. Nobody takes samples any more — the pendant is worn because next to it the plague takes its due _more slowly_.
Infection grows about _a quarter_ slower. In a bag the pendant does nothing — it has to be _worn_.
Works at _full strength_ and grows with mastery. For any other class it helps _half as much_.
item.lmpc_classes.clerics_brew.tooltip.s: The ordinary plague brew, finished the apothecary's way. It takes the illness at _any stage_, where a plain bottle no longer helps — but only a Cleric knows what to do with it.
item.lmpc_classes.clerics_brew.tooltip.b: Clears _infection_ and grants brief immunity. For any other class the bottle is simply wasted.
A Cleric _feeds_ an ally by holding right-click. Not from afar — you have to stand next to them.
One person can be helped once every _few minutes_. Before that a Cleric will not spend the bottle.
item.lmpc_classes.class_codex.tooltip.su: A crew's work journal: what you do, what you answer for, what you still have to learn. This one fills itself in — it holds _your calling_.
item.lmpc_classes.class_codex.tooltip.be: Opens your class: its _role_, its _abilities_ and how _mastery_ grows.
The codex is only read. Classes are changed at the _Altar of Calling_.
item.lmpc_classes.plague_bloom.tooltip.s: The first weed to sprout on poisoned ground. It was pulled and burned, until it turned out the cure was inside it. Grows wild in _infected chunks_.
item.lmpc_classes.plague_bloom.tooltip.b: Two blooms and a _glass bottle_ make a Cleansing Agent.
Only sprouts for a _Farmer_. In other hands it is still perfectly good material, just not a seed.
item.lmpc_classes.cleansing_agent.toolti: The solution greenhouses once used against mould. Nobody changed the recipe — they just found it another use. _Fuel_ for every kind of cleansing, by machine or by hand.
An andesite one spends _one_ per night and clears infection from the chunks around it. A brass one needs _four_ for the same night.
In your bag along with a Censer
Every puff spends _one_ agent. You do not need to hold it.
item.lmpc_classes.censer.tooltip.summary: A miner's lantern rebuilt for fumigation. A Purifier will never go underground, and the seam still has to be dug — so the agent is carried by hand.
item.lmpc_classes.censer.tooltip.behavio: Sprays the agent: the chunk gains _resistance_ to the plague and may lose an _infection level_. Resistance fades on its own, so a mine is fumigated while it is being worked.
_Does nothing_. Above ground that is the Purifier's job.
One agent and one point of _durability_, plus a pause of a few seconds.
block.lmpc_classes.andesite_purifier.too: An irrigation rig from the trial fields: it pumped solution through pipes and watered the crops. The solution has changed since — now the machine washes _infection_ off the ground around it every night. Anyone can place one.
Runs on Create _rotation_. Too slow and it stands still; spun up it cleanses harder. A working Purifier glows — you can see from afar that it has not stalled.
One Cleansing Agent per night. Empty it does nothing, and what is left comes back to you when the block is broken.
The higher the Smith's _mastery_, the harder it cleanses; with no Smith it works at half strength. A _wrench_ lets the Smith trigger Overdrive: one night wider and stronger for four times the agent.
Reports what is missing: rotation, agent or a Smith. The same is shown by _engineer's goggles_.
block.lmpc_classes.brass_purifier.toolti: The same irrigation rig, rebuilt in brass for a large holding. It cleanses a square of chunks _three times wider_ than the andesite one — and asks accordingly.
Only a Smith can place it
In other hands the block _will not go down_. Without a class there is the andesite Purifier — that one is open to everybody.
Needs a _faster_ shaft than the andesite one and eats _four_ agents a night instead of one. It also puts twice the load on the Create network.
Clears _infection_ from the chunks around it and raises their _resistance_ to the plague. Otherwise it is the same machine: the Smith's Overdrive and the right-click report both work.

class.lmpc_classes.farmer.ability.2: Plague bloom sprouts on tilled soil - only the Farmer knows how to plant it.
class.lmpc_classes.farmer.ability.3: Blighted grass in the Rot drops blooms - anyone may gather, only the Farmer may sow.
class.lmpc_classes.farmer.ability.4: A ripe crop sometimes yields more than it should - the chance grows with mastery.
msg.lmpc_classes.bloom.not_farmer: Only the Farmer knows how to plant a bloom.
msg.lmpc_classes.tune.failed: Could not change %s: config not loaded, or the value is out of range.
class.lmpc_classes.smith.ability.2: Andesite purifier: once a night it cleanses its own chunk, if turning and fuelled with reagent.
class.lmpc_classes.smith.ability.3: The purifier runs stronger while a Smith is online - its power scales with their tier.
class.lmpc_classes.smith.ability.4: Forged gear sometimes comes out already enchanted, and the forge and furnace grant experience - more often with mastery.
class.lmpc_classes.smith.ability.5: Overdrive: strike your own purifier with a wrench and the coming night runs at the reach of the tier above, at four times the reagent.
msg.lmpc_classes.purifier.no_power: The purifier stands still - no rotation.
msg.lmpc_classes.purifier.smith_only: Only a Smith can place the brass purifier.
msg.lmpc_classes.purifier.overdrive_on: Overdrive: tonight the purifier reaches further and eats four times the reagent.
msg.lmpc_classes.purifier.overdrive_alre: Overdrive is already on - it waits for the coming night.
msg.lmpc_classes.purifier.overdrive_smit: Only a Smith can squeeze more out of a purifier.
msg.lmpc_classes.purifier.dawn.cleansed: ✦ The night is worked: %1$s of %2$s made the land cleaner.
msg.lmpc_classes.purifier.dawn.held: ✧ The night is worked, but the plague held: none of %s took a level off.
msg.lmpc_classes.purifier.dawn.empty: ☢ Out of reagent: %s stopped until refilled.
msg.lmpc_classes.censer.open_sky: Under open sky the smoke is useless - a purifier belongs here.
msg.lmpc_classes.censer.no_reagent: Nothing to burn: you need cleansing agent.
msg.lmpc_classes.censer.cleansed: The smoke settles - the ground here is cleaner.
msg.lmpc_classes.censer.held: The smoke settles: no cleaner, but the plague will be slow to come here.
class.lmpc_classes.chronicler.ability.2: The exact infection level of the ground you are looking at.
class.lmpc_classes.chronicler.ability.3: A camera click reveals the infection map around you to the whole party for minutes.
class.lmpc_classes.chronicler.ability.4: Light step: the higher the mastery, the faster the Chronicler walks.
msg.lmpc_classes.snapshot.cooldown: The film is not ready yet: %s min.
msg.lmpc_classes.snapshot.no_data: Nothing to photograph: the plague is not tracked here.
lmpc_classes.ponder.andesite_purifier.te: Cleanses plague infection from the land around it
It runs on rotation only: rotation must come from straight below
One water wheel is enough: a gearbox only stands the shaft upright
Right-click with Cleansing Agent to load it. One is spent per night
Turning and loaded, it hums, sprays and glows
Once per night it cleanses the 3x3 chunks around it. A Smith in the party makes it stronger
Right-click empty-handed for a report: rotation, reagent and Smith tier
lmpc_classes.ponder.brass_purifier.text_: The second tier of purifier. Same job, much larger reach
It cleanses 7x7 chunks around itself instead of 3x3
It needs 32 RPM: a lone water wheel gives only 8
A Rotation Speed Controller under a large cogwheel sets exactly the speed you ask for
The purifier takes rotation from the cogwheel below: the shaft connects from below and nowhere else
It eats four reagents per night instead of one
Only a Smith can place it. In other hands the block will not go down
Assembled on Mechanical Crafters, not on a belt like the andesite one
